FIRST CONVERSATION

We start by reviewing your current setup.

We look at your primary service, target area in Budapest and current enquiry process to see where practical support makes sense.

Direct email contact: samigrowlab@gmail.com. Send a short note with your primary service, Budapest target area and website URL. We do not use tracking forms or cookies.

Topics for our first discussion

  • Which local service is most valuable to the business?
  • What do your current search presence and website show?
  • How does an enquiry turn into a quote or booking?
  • What can we test and measure within 90 days?

Does this require a new website?

Not necessarily. We review your existing pages and sales process before recommending structural changes.

NEXT STEPS

What happens after you reach out?

We do not send generic marketing templates or make unsolicited phone calls. We assess potential collaboration through a straightforward, transparent 3-step process.

STEP 01 · WITHIN 24 HOURS

Personal reply & initial check

The step: Within 24 hours of receiving your message, we send a personal response. We examine your current website and Google Business Profile, checking local search volume and competition.

STEP 02 · 30 MINUTES

Consultation & capacity review

The step: During a 30-minute phone or video conversation, we discuss your current team capacity, key services and how incoming customer enquiries are currently logged and quoted.

STEP 03 · DECISION

Written action plan & proposal

The step: We provide a concise proposal outlining recommended marketing channels, realistic media budget requirements and 90-day pilot milestones. Zero hidden commitments.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Contact and discovery details

Answers to common questions regarding how to get in touch, initial meetings and our audit scope.

What details should I provide in the first email?

Your business name, your website or social media page, the Budapest districts you serve, and the primary service you want to generate more enquiries for.

How quickly will I receive a reply?

We respond within 24 hours on all business days, having already completed a quick baseline check of your local search presence in Budapest.

Is there any financial commitment for the first consultation?

No, the initial discovery review and 30-minute consultation call are completely free and carry no obligation whatsoever.

Can we meet in person in Budapest?

Yes, following our initial phone or video alignment, we are pleased to meet in person with Budapest business owners to finalize operational details.
